# Format behavior {#sec-format-behavior}

This second appendix proves that appendix numbering advances from A to B and
that links can target appendix content without hard-coded display text.

## Reflowable fallback {#sec-appendix-reflowable-fallback}

HTML presents parts in navigation and gives each appendix its own page. EPUB
retains the chapters and alphabetic appendices but omits part-divider pages;
this is an intentional renderer limitation, not missing manuscript content.

## Print behavior {#sec-appendix-print-behavior}

Typst and LuaLaTeX provide designed division openers. Exact line and page
breaks may differ, while hierarchy, wording, numbering, and trim-specific
geometry remain equivalent.
